business_problem: New York State needed a secure and responsible way to train and equip a very large public-sector workforce to use generative AI in daily work while maintaining human oversight, quality controls, and statewide policy guardrails.
solution_summary: New York State, through the Office of Information Technology Services (ITS), expanded a generative AI enablement program from a 1,200-person pilot across eight agencies to statewide availability for more than 100,000 employees. The implementation combines InnovateUS for formal responsible-AI instruction with AI Pro, a secure generative AI assistant developed by ITS and powered by Google Gemini. In practice, state employees first receive structured training on appropriate public-sector AI use, then use AI Pro as the controlled interface for prompt submission and response generation. Gemini provides the underlying LLM capabilities for drafting, summarization, simplification, and dashboard-related assistance, while ITS governs access and rollout across 50+ supported agencies. The source describes prompt ingestion, model-powered processing, and delivery of outputs back to employees, but does not disclose storage architecture or back-end data persistence details. Human oversight and a statewide acceptable-use policy are core operational controls.

solution_components.name: AI Pro
solution_components.role: Secure generative AI assistant used by New York State employees to practice and apply AI in day-to-day government work.

solution_components.name: Google Gemini
solution_components.role: Underlying generative AI model that powers AI Pro's drafting, summarization, and language-generation capabilities.

solution_components.name: InnovateUS
solution_components.role: Online training platform used to deliver responsible AI education to the New York State workforce.

data_flow: State employees complete responsible-AI training through InnovateUS, then submit prompts through AI Pro. AI Pro provides the secure user environment and sends requests to Google Gemini for generation. Responses are returned to employees for tasks such as executive summaries, policy briefs, report summarization, document consolidation, and dashboard creation, with human oversight emphasized throughout.

business_outcome: The state scaled a secure generative AI training and assistant program from a multi-agency pilot to the largest statewide public-sector rollout in the U.S., improving employee AI literacy, saving time, and supporting better service delivery to residents.
